title: Hulk-Smash-Proof Iron Man
tagline: For when your toddler’s tantrums reach Hulk-level intensity. This Hulkbuster figure isn’t just a toy—it’s a peace treaty. Perfect for the parent who’s tired of explaining why the Hulk can’t babysit. Just don’t let your kid find out it’s worth more than their college fund.

title: Hammock for Your Head

title: Retro Gaming Shame
tagline: For when you want to play Pokémon on your iPhone, but still pretend it's 1999. This bamboo Game Boy case is perfect for confusing your friends at a hipster café.

title: Tortilla Snuggle Blanket

title: Visor of Vulnerability

Perfect for the weekend warrior who wants to spend more time assembling their home than actually enjoying the great outdoors.

title: Pants for Pretending
tagline: For when you need to convince your boss you're actually doing yoga at your desk, not just scrolling through Twitter.

title: Crunchy Critter Snack Pack
tagline: For when your survivalist friend insists on 'roughing it' but can't handle a can of beans. This bag of bugs is the perfect bridge between camping and a gourmet snack. Ideal for post-apocalyptic dinner parties or convincing your in-laws you're 'one with nature.'

title: Sunny’s Divine Intervention
tagline: When your life needs a little more 'Dennis Reynolds Energy' and a lot less 'Frank’s Van Down by the River', these candles are your Hail Mary. tagline: For when you want to casually drop that you're wearing a 65-million-year-old dinosaur bone and a meteorite to your book club meeting.

title: Peeing Sponge Butler
tagline: For the 3am bathroom trip where you don't want to put the sponge down, this holder is here to judge you silently.

title: The 'Oops, I Deleted That' Spray
tagline: Ever accidentally delete your grocery list mid-shopping? Now you can just spray it back into existence. This isn't a printer, it's a time machine for your mistakes. Perfect for the digital minimalist who still wants to live in the Stone Age. Just don't ask how it handles PDFs.

tagline: For the wedding where the ring bearer is also the designated snack thief. This polo ensures the ring stays put while little Timmy's sticky fingers are otherwise occupied with cake frosting. Bonus: the pocket doubles as a napkin holder for post-ceremony chaos.

title: Candlelight Mac & Cheese
tagline: For when your microwave’s on the fritz and you’ve got a hankering for comfort food that’s more aromatic than edible. Light this candle and pretend you’re a gourmet chef, or use it to mask the smell of last night’s questionable takeout. Either way, your kitchen’s never smelled so... cheesy.

title: Seal Your Nerdy Fate
tagline: For the true Harry Potter fan who needs to sign their tax returns with a Hogwarts crest, these wax seals are a must. Imagine the look on your accountant's face.

title: Kite Me Maybe
tagline: Because your backyard needs a 6-foot fighter jet, spend $129.95 on this F-35 kite for those awkward family gatherings where you fly a giant plane over your in-laws' heads.

title: Truck Bed Tents for Overachievers
tagline: Because setting up a tent in 30 seconds isn’t fast enough, here’s a pop-up camper that turns your truck bed into a cozy cave in 90. Perfect for the 'I need to leave the campsite before sunrise to beat traffic' crowd or those who’ve decided glamping is too mainstream.

title: Inferno in a Bag
tagline: For the friend who thinks a 5-alarm fire in their mouth is a good time, this gummy bear brings the heat. Literally. Serve at a dinner party to weed out the faint of heart.

title: Galactic Party Killer
tagline: When your rave gets too lit, summon the dark side with this Death Star disco ball. Imagine the looks on your friends' faces when you drop this 540-dollar space station into the mix, because who needs a social life, anyway?

title: Gnome Apocalypse Now
tagline: For the neighbor who's been asking for a lawn makeover, gift them a gnome impaled on a spike. It's the perfect 'I'm watching you' decoration for your overgrown garden, silently judging their lawn care habits.

title: Spin to Win: The Lazy Cyclist's Dream
tagline: Forget about pedaling uphill to impress your date—just slap this motorized monstrosity on your bike and pretend you're an Olympic athlete. Perfect for those who want to look like they're exercising while actually conserving energy for important things, like arguing about politics on Twitter.

title: Caramelize Your Beer
tagline: For when you're camping and decide beer isn't gross enough, this tool caramelizes it over a campfire, because who needs a decent pint in the wilderness?

title: MacGyver's Last Stand
tagline: For when your Swiss Army knife feels too *civilized*. This grenade-shaped paracord ball is the survivalist’s answer to a zombie apocalypse—except the zombies are your in-laws and the apocalypse is Thanksgiving. Unravel it to find a fishing hook, fire starter, and enough rope to tie your brother-in-law to a chair. Just don’t ask what’s in the ‘secret compartment.’

title: Pillow for Meat Lovers
tagline: For when your couch is too vegan. This throw pillow is the perfect middle finger to your vegetarian roommate who keeps stealing your snacks. Now you can nap on a burger while they stare in silent judgment. Comes with a side of existential dread about your dietary choices.
